speech_style: Speak in clear Philippine English as the same warm adult female Kore community health trainer throughout. Keep a stable feminine mid-register for headings, dialogue, questions and endings. Preserve exact words, negations, numbers and pending-agreement qualifications. No speaker switching or added words. Pronounce Carole clearly, consistently and naturally.

beats.text: The fictional scenario supplies verified work and childcare barriers. Carole compares a poster with discussion of a small schedule trial.
Cause, proposal, owner, resources, deadline, measure and review date. Consult first; staff time and a trial date remain pending.
Carole handles consultation; the responsible health team decides schedules. Include seldom-heard residents. Silence does not establish agreement.
A separate review exercise supplies agreement to an earlier trial. One of three invited households attended before and after. Two still missed visits.
A completed meeting is not an outcome. Recheck work, costs, childcare and notice. Present the plan, answer partner questions, revise and retry.
Carole returns the proposal to the team. Staff time and a trial date remain pending. Review attendance after an agreed trial; do not claim the problem solved.
